details.description: As ghostly music emanates from the piano, a ghostly woman in a ballroom gown shimmers in the air and takes your hand, leading you in a dance...
details.reset: The haunt automatically resets after 1 day until the supernatural fungus in B37 is dealt with, even if the haunt was previously disabled.
details.routine:
Dance Reaction. Trigger A Creature touches any of the piano keys - Haunted character must make a  @Check[type:will|dc:23|name:Suggestion|traits:mental,incapacitating,linguistic,necromancy,occult] save to avoid or be drawn into the Haunt's routine.

Wrathful Shriek: R   Trigger A creature caught in the haunt’s routine is successfully grappled or restrained. All creatures in B7 must make a DC23 basic will save against 4d6 mental damage- (if a feilure the creature becomes @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}1, or @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} 2 on a critical failure- This stupeﬁed condition reduces by 1 after a full night’s rest.

Routine. Routine: For 1d6 rounds, the Haunt and any creature caught by “Dance" continue to dance. The dancing creature must make a DC17 Perform check each round, or have their @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled} enfeebled value increase by 1, to a maximum of @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}4. This enfeebled condition is reduced by 1 after a full night's rest. Any creature whose enfeebled value would increase beyond 4, or any creature who is enfeebled when the routine ends, becomes @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Vengeful Haunt: This Haunt only affects those haunted by Iesha Foxgmne, Aidan's murdered wife who desires vengeance for her murdmer. If no creatures in a goup are haunted by lesha Foxglove, this haunt may target any creature.

Actions: 1
